description: Set up a price alert. Canonical delivery field is `webhook_url`; the legacy `webhook` spelling is still accepted as an alias. Provide AT LEAST ONE of `webhook_url` or `email` (and not both). Conditions: `above`, `below`, or `volatility_pct` with a numeric threshold (USD or %). Proxies the existing /api/v1/alerts endpoint.
name: subscribe_alert
title: Subscribe to a price alert
